title: π0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
abstract: π0.5 builds on π0 and co-trains a unified vision-language-action model on heterogeneous robot, semantic, verbal-instruction, and web data. A discrete-token pre-training stage is followed by a mobile-manipulation post-training stage with a flow-matching action expert. The resulting hierarchical policy predicts a high-level semantic subtask and then a low-level continuous action chunk, enabling multi-stage kitchen and bedroom cleanup in unseen homes.
